lessons_used: Reordering sign-in after adoption was helpful in one test (+7.0%), though a second attempt showed no clear effect.
Introducing a new flow on home (+8.6%) and specific hints for adoption (+5.4%) and path decisions (+3.1%) were helpful.
Streamlining path selection copy hurt performance (-4.7%), and sign-in restore hints also hurt performance (-5.8%).
Layout updates, background notifications, wait info, tutorial screens, incentives, and other copy changes showed no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too optimistic, overestimating expected gains for most tests.
Predictions were too low for the winning home new flow (+1.0% predicted vs +8.6% measured) and path decision hint (+0.5% predicted vs +3.1% measured).

candidates.title: Spotlight Path Selection Experience
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen layout to a spotlight layout that highlights key companion traits and path expectations.
candidates.why: Path selection drop-off is 23.9% with a high mean completion time of 514s; spotlighting choices helps users decide quickly.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Experience
choose_path.body: Select whether to build a custom pet companion from photos or adopt a ready-to-play pet friend.

guard.reason: Redesigns choose_path layout while maintaining both adopt and make custom pet options.

candidates.score_note: Layout redesigns for choose_path showed no clear positive effect historically.

candidates.title: Pet Style Preference Showcase Screen
candidates.change: Introduce a dedicated style selection screen before pick_friend to let users preview visual archetypes before adopting.
candidates.why: Adoption stage drops off significantly to 64.2% and support received emails about custom pets failing or looking wrong.

new_style_preview.headline: Preview Companion Styles
new_style_preview.body: Browse animated visual styles to find the look that best fits your desktop environment.

guard.reason: Adds a style preview screen within onboarding while preserving all mandatory steps.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off and strong support evidence, but adding new screens often adds friction.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Arrival Readiness Flow
candidates.change: Transform the waiting screen into a checklist activity flow where users configure desktop pet behavior preferences during loading.
candidates.why: The waiting home step has a long median duration of 201s (mean 2336s); engaging users in setup reduces perceived wait drop-off.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet Desktop Environment
waiting.body: Configure your pet desktop settings while your companion is being generated.

guard.reason: Redesigns waiting screen into a checklist activity while explicitly communicating pet generation.

candidates.score_note: New interactive flows on home step have proven highly effective (+8.6% previously).

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Quick Control Showcase
candidates.change: Redesign home_intro into a split layout screen showcasing essential desktop controls for summoning, hiding, and talking to the pet.
candidates.why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% and multiple support emails complained of confusion over how to control or summon pets post-setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready on Desktop!
home_intro.body: Use keyboard shortcuts or the tray icon to command, converse with, or hide your desktop pet anytime.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro to highlight desktop companion controls within allowed onboarding changes.

candidates.score_note: Strong support and funnel evidence, but layout redesigns historically show minimal lift.

candidates.title: Account Sync Identity Security Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit security hint on sign_in explaining that account creation protects custom pets from being reset or lost.
candidates.why: The #1 support theme (8 emails) was pets missing or reset after signing in again, making persistence assurances critical.

sign_in.hint: Signing in anchors your pet to your account so your custom companion is safely backed up.

guard.reason: Adds an informative security hint on sign_in without violating any base rules.

candidates.score_note: Top support theme, but sign-in hints previously hurt conversion (-5.8%).

candidates.title: Custom Pet Generation Photo Quality Hint
candidates.change: Display a target quality photo framing tip on upload_photos to ensure custom pet photo generation succeeds on the first attempt.
candidates.why: Users reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results; clear input guidance prevents processing failures.

upload_photos.hint: For best generation accuracy, upload clear photos with full lighting and your pet centered.

guard.reason: Adds a helpful photo quality tip on upload_photos.

candidates.score_note: Adoption stage has highest drop-off, strong support alignment, and adoption hints previously gained +5.4%.

candidates.title: Card Carousel Story Intro Layout
candidates.change: Switch the onboarding story screen to a carousel layout illustrating pet features and interactions.
candidates.why: First step drop-off is 23.9%; dynamic visual card layouts build early emotional engagement before decision steps.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Pet World

guard.reason: Redesigns story screen layout to a carousel while continuing to introduce the pet world.

candidates.score_note: Layout changes show no clear historical effect on conversion.

candidates.title: Pet Identity Saver Sign-In Callout
candidates.change: Add a prominent protection badge component on sign_in emphasizing instant cloud backup for personalized pets.
candidates.why: Sign-in drop-off is 21.8% and users worry about pet loss across sessions.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Tray Shortcut Hint
candidates.change: Add a hint on home_intro clarifying how to access the pet from the desktop system tray when minimized.
candidates.why: Support tickets highlight user confusion regarding missing desktop pets and unresponsiveness after completing setup.

home_intro.hint: Tip: Click the pet icon in your system tray anytime to summon or manage your pet on desktop.

guard.reason: Adds a system tray usage hint to home_intro.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step with strong support complaints; low-cost hint has good potential.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate First Customization Order
candidates.change: Reorder adoption screens so adoption_certificate happens immediately after pick_friend before photo uploads.
candidates.why: Naming the pet early reinforces ownership commitment before users enter the photo upload phase.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

lessons_next: Helpful changes (won): Reordering sign-in after adoption, a new home flow, targeted hints (adoption, path decision, sign-in security), and a path selection layout update significantly improved metrics.
Harmful changes (worse): Streamlined path selection copy (-4.7%) and an account persistence sign-in hint (-5.8%) significantly hurt performance.
No clear effect: Notifications, tutorial/showcase screens, wait time info, incentives, and most copy changes showed no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Expected gains were generally overestimated across most tests, including large predicted gains like +15.0% and +14.0%.

Predictions too low: Predictions underestimated gains for multiple winning tests, including the home new flow (+1.0% vs +8.6%), path decision hint (+0.5% vs +3.1%), sign-in security hint (-4.0% vs +3.1%), and card carousel layout (+0.8% vs +5.3%).
